description: Amounts show as whole birr with thousands separators, e.g. "58,400 ETB"
All business dates, cutoffs and "today" are computed in Africa/Addis_Ababa through one helper, independent of server time zone
Phone input accepted as 09..., 07..., 9..., +251... and normalised to E.164 +2519XXXXXXXX / +2517XXXXXXXX; invalid numbers rejected
Gregorian dates in the UI; user-facing strings kept in one strings file per feature
Staff sign in with email and password
Clients sign in with phone number and password (no SMS verification)
Staff with operations role can reset a client password
Roles are a set per user; one user can hold several roles (e.g. operations + delivery)
Each role is routed to its home screen and blocked from other areas
Anonymous users can read only the public calculator settings and packages
A client can read only their own client record, plan, invoices, payments, orders and check-ins
A client cannot read or change another client's records through any service
Kitchen can read production data but cannot read payments or change prices
Delivery can read only drops (name, phone, address) for the day and update drop status
Only owners can apply manual discounts and edit pricing settings
Nutritionist can set targets and approve swaps; operations cannot override nutrition targets
Receipt files are private: only the uploading client and staff with payments access get a signed URL
Signed file URLs expire and invalid signatures are refused
No database URL, bucket key, auth secret or cron secret is present in client JavaScript bundles
Every server action and route validates input with Zod and checks the caller's role
Job routes reject requests without the correct cron secret
Phone numbers and addresses never appear in community responses
Migrations apply cleanly to an empty Postgres and create every table in PLAN.md
All keys are UUIDs; money columns are integer birr; statuses are enums or checks
Audit log row (who, what, before, after, when) for changes to prices, settings, nutrition targets, discounts, payment confirmations and moderation
Seed loads all 48 ingredients with empty prices and nutrition per 100 g or per piece
Seed loads menus A–D with 16 meals plus the savory snack alternative, with parts and part ingredients as in SPEC doc 4
Seed loads the 10-row starter swap table, three packages, pricing, nutrition and schedule settings
Seed creates demo users for every role and 10 demo clients with varied goals, sizes, allergies, plans and delivery options, all marked is_demo
One script removes all demo data and leaves reference data intact
Storage keys use prefixes receipts/, community/, avatars/; local folder driver in dev/test, S3 driver selected by env
Lead capture with source (Instagram, referral, walk-in, other) creates a client with status lead
Sign-up form captures age, sex, weight, height, activity, goal, allergies, dislikes, address, area, delivery or pick-up
Client status lifecycle lead → active → paused → ended is enforced
Client list with filters by status, plan, area and payment status
Client page shows profile, nutrition, plan, swaps, payments, orders, check-ins, notes and audit trail
Consultation with the nutritionist is recorded (in person or phone, notes)
Onboarding wizard takes a lead through intake, macros, plan, swaps and invoice
Allergy/dislike conflicts without a swap are shown in red on the client page
BMR with Mifflin-St Jeor for men and women matches known values
TDEE uses activity factors 1.2 / 1.375 / 1.55 / 1.725 / 1.9
Goal adjustment Lean ×0.80, Build ×1.10, editable in settings
Size is nearest of S 1,600 / M 2,100 / L 2,700; ties go smaller for Lean, larger for Build
Macro split Lean 30/40/30, Build 25/50/25 using 4/4/9 kcal per gram, editable
Nutritionist override stores who, when and the computed suggestion next to the override
Client cannot change their own calorie target or size; they can request a change
Quick-start clients get a provisional size from the calculator; nutritionist sees them in a confirm-within-48h queue
Rotation Mon A, Tue B, Wed C, Thu D, Fri A, Sat B, Sun C; service days Mon–Sat by default
Sunday meals are cooked and delivered with Saturday's drop when Sunday is not a service day (setting)
Each meal is built from parts with a category and ingredients; seasoning parts are on recipe cards but not in macros
Every seeded meal's base macros match a hand calculation from ingredient nutrition
Egg whites use derived nutrition (17 kcal per white) and consume one egg each for stock and cost
Meal cost per portion computed from ingredient prices; shows "price missing" when any price is empty
Portion profiles: six profiles (3 sizes × 2 goals) with scale factors for protein, carb+fruit and fat parts
Each profile menu day lands within ±3% of the size kcal target and each macro within ±10% of the goal split, or is flagged
Scale factors are clamped between 0.6 and 1.8; closest result kept and day flagged when targets cannot be met
Veg and sauce parts stay at base grams; Greek yogurt and ayib count as protein
Grams rounded to nearest 5 g; eggs, egg whites and injera to whole pieces
Computed profile grams are stored; nutritionist edits are kept and marked manual on recompute
Every meal shows kcal, protein, carbs and fat per profile
Pantry items (awaze, garlic, lemon, rosemary, herbs, salt, pepper) listed on recipe cards as "pantry"
Swap table rules apply like-for-like: same grams, fixed grams, multiplier, or added protein
Beans → +60 g lean minced beef; injera → 45 g dry rice; rice → 150 g potatoes; feta/mozzarella → double grams ayib
Sweet snack → savory snack (2 boiled eggs, cucumber, mitmita) counts as a swap
Standing swap limit per package (Essential 3, Performance 6, Premium 10) enforced on the server
Swaps outside the swap table need nutritionist approval
Swap extra cost: zero or price difference, included in the client's food cost
Paid add-on extra protein (+50 g main protein) priced at cost × (1 + buffer) ÷ (1 − margin floor), rounded up to 10 ETB
Allergies and dislikes are checked against every meal's ingredients after swaps
Swap changes take effect from the next lockable week only
Staff can edit the swap table
Pricing formula reproduced exactly: food_day, buffered food, delivery_day, consult_day, fixed_day, price_day, price_month, plan_price
price_month rounded to nearest 100 ETB
Buffers by food group and other pricing defaults as in SPEC doc 6, owner-editable with change log
Drops per month by delivery option: daily 26, three drops 78, every 3 days 9, weekly 4.33, pick-up 0
Plan price = price_month + package service fee (default 0)
Missing ingredient prices block publishing a client price and list the missing ingredients
Prices are locked for four months from subscription start; owner can apply a change earlier with a logged reason
Manual discounts need an owner and are logged with who and why
Packages Essential / Performance / Premium with swap limit, check-in interval, coaching and delivery options, owner-editable
Goal (Lean/Build) is a setting inside every package
Calculator shows an indicative price only when every needed ingredient price exists
Weekly or monthly invoices generated per subscription with integer birr amounts
Client pays by Telebirr, CBE or cash and uploads a receipt photo (compressed client-side)
Ops confirmation queue with receipt preview; confirm is one tap; reject needs a reason
Payment confirmation writes an audit row and marks the invoice paid when fully covered
Unpaid = not cooked: days not covered by a paid invoice at the cutoff are left out of the order
Invoice generation is idempotent (one invoice per subscription, kind and period)
Thursday 18:00 Addis lock creates next week's orders for active, paid clients with days, meals, profile, swaps and pauses
Thursday cutoff boundaries: a change at 17:59 Thursday applies next week; at 18:00 or later the week after
Paused weeks produce a paused order with no days
Locked orders snapshot grams after swaps so later menu edits do not change them
Weekly order review before and after lock shows locked, skipped for non-payment and paused, with conflicts in red
Quick start: sign up and pay by 18:00 starts the next service day
Quick start at 17:59 vs 18:01 Addis time gives different start days
Quick start on a Saturday starts Monday when Sunday is not a service day
When the daily quick-start capacity (default 5) is full, the next available start date is offered
Quick-start price = price per day × service days in the quick-start period, rounded to nearest 10
Quick-start clients start on the standard menu with no swaps and a provisional size
Daily 18:00 job adds paid quick-start clients to the next day's production sheet and packing list; nothing cooked on spec
Quick-start clients join the normal weekly cycle from the next Thursday cutoff
Weekly lock is idempotent: running twice creates no duplicate orders
Production sheet per cook day: total grams of each part by profile × count, with totals
Recipe cards per meal with portions per profile and pantry items
Packing list per client with swaps applied and allergy conflicts in red
Labels print client first name + last initial, meal, slot, profile, kcal/P/C/F, cook date, eat-by, allergy note, "Reheat until steaming hot"
Eat-by = cook date + 3 days; meals with fish or injera = cook date + 2 days
Production sheet, packing list and labels print cleanly on A4 and read on a phone
Quick-start meals appear on the next day's production sheet with a quick-start marker
Shopping list = required ingredients from locked orders minus stock on hand
Shopping list never goes negative and converts to purchase units kg, litre, piece
Egg whites count as eggs in the shopping list and stock
Purchase log with supplier, quantity, price and date; latest purchase price updates ingredient cost and price history
Stock count per ingredient with one tap per line; Sunday count resets on-hand
Waste log reduces stock on hand
Next-morning top-up purchase list for fresh items needed by quick starts
Ingredients with missing price show "price missing" in the shopping list cost
Daily drop list grouped by area in route order
Ops can drag to reorder drops and assign riders
Rider view with tap-to-call, address and one-tap delivered
Failed drop requires a reason
Pick-up list for the cafe counter for pick-up clients
Drops are generated from locked order days by delivery option (one drop daily, three drops, Saturday includes Sunday)
Drop generation is idempotent
Public calorie calculator works without login and shows TDEE, size and macros
Public sign-up creates a lead and then a client account (phone + password)
Today screen shows today's meals with macros and eat-by dates
This week's menu with the client's profile portions
My plan shows package, delivery, price, macros and size; size change can only be requested
Client can request swaps within the plan limit, effective next week
Client can pause in whole weeks before the cutoff; paused weeks extend the plan end date
Invoices list with receipt upload
Client logs weight; progress chart shows check-ins
Telegram opt-in from profile via one-time deep link
Client app works at 390 px wide
Weekly check-ins with weight, nutritionist notes and adherence
Check-in reminder on each client's check-in weekday
Renewal reminders 5 days and 1 day before a plan ends
Nutritionist check-in log screen
Pay before cooking: unconfirmed payment at the relevant cutoff leaves the client out
One cutoff for changes: swaps, pauses, address and size changes take effect from next lockable week
Pause in whole weeks extends the end date; no refund
Pause after the cutoff for a week is refused for that week
Address changes made after the cutoff apply from the following week (drop snapshot keeps old address)
Stock count reminder every Sunday before the week's cooking
Owner dashboard: active clients, new and churned this month, MRR
Collected vs invoiced this month
Food cost % of revenue from purchases and margin estimate
On-time delivery % and quick starts this week
Average meal rating per meal over the last 4 weeks
Clients needing attention: unpaid, allergy conflicts, no check-in for 2 weeks
Partner contribution log with partner, date, type, amount or hours, note, and totals per partner
Dashboard screen renders for owners only
Feed: text posts with up to 4 photos, newest first, pinned on top, paginated
Photos compressed client-side to at most 1,600 px on the long edge
Comments one level deep and reactions (like, fire, strong)
Progress posts attach weight change from own check-ins only when "share this" is ticked
Weekly challenges with daily yes check-in once per day, streaks and leaderboard
Q&A post type; coaches mark one reply as the answer
Coach posts carry a "Coach" badge; coaches post announcements, pin posts, run challenges
Meal ratings 1–5 with optional comment on the today screen, private by default
Members can report posts or comments; reports go to an ops queue and a staff Telegram alert
Ops/owners hide posts or comments with a reason and mute members for a set time (audited)
Active members full access; paused read and react only; ended lose access 14 days after plan end
Members show as first name + last initial with optional avatar
Community notifications: replies, coach announcements, challenge reminders; Telegram at most a daily digest
Community screens work at 390 px
In-app notification centre with unread count and mark as read
Telegram adapter sends when a bot token is configured and the user is linked
Without a bot token, notifications fall back to in-app only and the app keeps working
Staff and clients link Telegram with a deep link carrying a one-time token
Sending a real Telegram message to a real chat (needs a real bot token)
Tuesday 10:00 reminder to every active client about changes and payment due Thursday 18:00
Thursday 16:00 last-call reminder to clients with unpaid invoices
Thursday 18:00 lock + invoice generation + ops summary (locked, skipped, paused)
Friday 08:00 shopping list built and link sent to ops
Daily 18:00 quick-start lock, top-up list, counts to kitchen and ops
Daily 06:00 production sheet link to kitchen and route link to riders
Sunday 17:00 stock count reminder to kitchen
Daily 09:00 renewal and check-in reminders
Every job is idempotent: running twice does not double-lock, double-charge or double-notify
CRON.md lists exact schedules in UTC and Addis time for Railway cron
Owner settings: pricing, packages, nutrition defaults, service days, cutoff times, quick-start capacity, swap table, areas
Settings changes are validated with Zod and written to the change log
Ingredient prices and nutrition values editable by staff
Web app manifest, icons and installable PWA
Offline fallback page served by the service worker
Every list has an empty state that says what to do next
Every action shows success or a specific error
Staff screens work at 390 px and 1280 px (screenshots reviewed)
Client pages under 200 KB first-load JS where practical (Next build output)
Inputs have labels; tap targets at least 44 px on phone screens
Text colour contrast meets WCAG AA for the brand palette
Week-in-the-life simulation passes from the seed with asserted counts and totals
Simulation report saved to docs/simulation-report.md
README, DEPLOY, CRON, DECISIONS and PROGRESS are complete and accurate
scripts/init.sh installs, starts local Postgres, migrates, seeds and starts the dev server
npm run verify runs typecheck, lint, unit, db tests, e2e and the simulation and fails on any failure

Quest brand tokens (Deep Forest, Fresh Lime, Morning Mist, Oat, Charcoal, Sage, Tangerine) mapped onto the shadcn theme in light and dark; themeColor and manifest colours; every text pair passes WCAG AA
Logo from the brand guideline in the staff sidebar (reversed), staff and client top bars, login, sign-up, public home, calculator and offline; favicon and PWA icons from the mark
Inter (self-hosted via next/font) with semibold headings and tabular numbers for macros, money and counts
One StatusBadge for every status (word + colour, never colour alone); no hand-set amber/red/emerald classes left
Loading skeletons per area, brand error and not-found pages with a way back, AlertDialog confirmations instead of window.confirm, 8 s Undo for rider Failed and counter Hand over
Login and sign-up phone field with a fixed +251 prefix; normalizeEthiopianPhone stays the single source of truth; staff sign in by email
Calculator and sign-up choices: the selected option is filled Deep Forest with a check icon
Public home: brand hero with the logo and an optional public/brand/hero.jpg slot; signed-in visitors see Go to my app for their role
Staff sidebar grouped into Today, Clients & money, Kitchen & delivery, Community, Admin with icons; role filtering kept, empty sections hidden; Notifications with unread count visible at 1280x720
Staff Today is a to-do list (one row per action with count and button, only actions the role can do); All clear with the next cutoff countdown
One underline tab style (horizontal scroll with fade on phones) on Nutrition, Purchasing, Community, Settings and the client page; Settings tabs fit at 1280
Tables become cards below md (key fields + More); at md+ sticky first column and scroll inside the table: profile table, production, recipes, weekly orders, purchasing
Ingredients settings open on Missing price while any price is missing; one Save per row
Stock count shows 'Kitchen or operations staff complete the count' to viewers who cannot edit
Kitchen sheets: 18 px high-contrast text, roomier rows, 44 px tick boxes (device only); A4 print unchanged
Client bottom tabs with icons; Swaps, Pause, Payments and Profile live under Plan; pay banner stays on Today when an invoice is due
Client Today hero: drop status, calorie ring against the target, meals in slot order
Client menu: Mon-Sun day strip with today highlighted
Deadline countdowns (Change by Thu 6 pm · 2 d 7 h left) on client Today, Swaps, Pause, Payments and staff Today; cutoff instants from the server, Addis time via src/domain/time.ts
Railway crons run on alpine:3.20 with a working wget start command (CRON.md/DEPLOY.md); GET /api/jobs/health shows the last run per job and overdue jobs; owner Dashboard Scheduled jobs card
